title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, the exact empirical C2--C7 camera geometry including the C4/C6 antipodal channels, the sharp critical cutoff-tail expansion with explicit remainder, the collective raw-energy expansion, and the exact logarithmic first/second cutoff jets generated by M^(-s-1). Version 0.9.0 adds the exact differentiated-remainder transport: supplied value, first-derivative, and second-derivative bounds for a scaled cutoff model propagate to first-jet and second-jet errors with the sharp algebraic factors (1+||log M||) and (1+||log M||)^2. The analytic production of those three bounds for the exact tail remains a separate theorem gate. Empirical cutoff-doubling campaigns are retained only as discovery and reproducibility provenance, not as proof dependencies.
